correctness.rationale: For all \(q,m\ge2\) and \(0<\rho<1\) the modulation DFT is a unitary column transform. In each of m fibers the q selected columns are positive multiples of columns of the invertible cyclic-geometric circulant \(C_R\), whose DFT eigenvalues \((1-R^q)/(1-R\omega^{-k})\) have nonzero denominator and numerator. This proves the exact rank formula, with q full-rank fibers iff the selected remainders agree by the circular 1->0 binary-transition argument. For the cosets the spectrum follows from \(C_R\) \(C_R\)*, and determinant from the product of its eigenvalues. The derivative of squared condition number is monotone via J(R)=1+2(1+c)R/(1-R)^2, giving one global optimal taper; direct small-case checks tested 506 masks, 36 spectral multisets and determinants, 42 optimizer pairs. The proof, not finite tests, establishes all dimensions.

value.rationale: The natural minimum-cardinality sampling design for q translations and m subgroup modulations has \(qm\) atoms for \(qm\)-dimensional signals. For a full-support geometric taper the exact universal rank formula is not a single ad hoc case: only m out of \(\binom{qm}{q}\) translation choices work, with complete explicit spectral multiplicities, sharp frame bounds, exact determinant, and a unique optimally conditioned taper for every \(q,m\ge2\). It resolves a complete meaningful classification and gives an optimal design and both endpoint stability obstructions, beyond direct rank computation for isolated small dimensions.
